Subject: OrionTek vendor setup — W-9 format issue

Hi Nina,

Thanks for starting the vendor setup. I pulled the W-9 you uploaded to the portal and our tax check flagged the EIN field: the PDF shows the EIN as '12-345' (truncated) which prevents us from validating the taxpayer file. Can you re-export the W-9 from QuickBooks/your tax software (full 9 digits) and re-upload? Small checklist:

- Export as PDF (not image/JPEG)
- Make sure page 1 includes company legal name and full EIN in the correct fields
- Use the portal 'Replace document' function so we keep the same submission id

If there are restrictions on sharing the full EIN, you can instead upload a bank letter or IRS 147C as an alternative — we just need an official doc that shows the full EIN and company legal name.

I've attached the copy we received (OrionTek_W9.pdf) and it looks like the export trimmed the EIN field.

Next steps: please re-upload by EOD US PT so procurement can push the PO live.

Appreciate it,

Ben Carter
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads up, Ben.

Nina — bank letter is acceptable if it meets these minimums:
- Bank letter on bank letterhead
- Bank officer name + phone or bank stamp
- Shows legal entity name and full EIN

A scanned PDF is fine as long as the content is legible and the file isn't password-protected. If you're seeing a 500 when replacing, please try clearing cache or use the 'Upload new document' flow and reply here with the new Doc ID so we can reconcile.

Ben — procurement can lift the PO hold once we have either the corrected W-9 or the bank letter. Laura, can you confirm PO timeline?

Kimberly
